title: Hash Garden Hymn
style: gospel-tinged folk, hammond organ, acoustic guitar, gentle tambourine, soulful female lead, choir backing harmonies, 70 bpm, sacred, hopeful, spiritual americana
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Every seed I planted has a name
Every name has a number all its own
Every number is a kind of prayer
For a flower that the wind has known

[Verse 2]
Nothing in the garden disappears
Nothing in the garden is a lie
What I plant in love is what I get
What I get in love won't ever die

[Chorus]
Hallelujah for the hash, hallelujah for the seed
Hallelujah for the proof of every kindness, every deed
Hallelujah for the truth that doesn't bend
Hallelujah for the love without an end

[Verse 3]
My grandma kept a Bible by the bed
With every birthday written in the back
A ledger written in her gentle hand
A garden growing on a paper track

[Chorus]
Hallelujah for the hash, hallelujah for the seed
Hallelujah for the proof of every kindness, every deed
Hallelujah for the truth that doesn't bend
Hallelujah for the love without an end

[Bridge]
What we plant remains, what we plant remains
What we plant remains, even in the rain
What we plant remains, what we plant remains
What we plant remains, even in the pain

[Outro]
Hallelujah, hallelujah
Hallelujah, hallelujah
The garden remembers your name
The garden remembers your name
